frame-an-insight-question.stage: Stage1 Bound the question and authority
frame-an-insight-question.responsibility: Purpose, boundary, authority, measures and a decision-relevant question

audit-an-observation.stage: Stage2 Audit the evidence before the story
audit-an-observation.responsibility: Observation versus interpretation, calibration, provenance and artifacts

synthesize-claim-relevant-sources.stage: Stage3 Find the knowledge the question needs
synthesize-claim-relevant-sources.responsibility: Claim-oriented extraction, evidence families, contradictions and access limits

generate-competing-explanations.stage: Stage4 Build rival explanations and a model
generate-competing-explanations.responsibility: Rival mechanisms, observation artifacts and contrary predictions

build-an-explanatory-model.stage: Stage4 Build rival explanations and a model
build-an-explanatory-model.responsibility: Variables, units, relationships, limiting cases and applicability

design-a-discriminating-test.responsibility: Comparators, manipulation, controls, independent units and safe stopping

execute-a-bounded-test.stage: Stage6 Execute and preserve what happened
execute-a-bounded-test.responsibility: Actual execution, configurations, deviations, raw results and authority

evaluate-results-and-uncertainty.stage: Stage7 Evaluate the explanation and its limits
evaluate-results-and-uncertainty.responsibility: Effect, uncertainty, execution validity and inconclusive conclusions

challenge-and-replicate-an-explanation.stage: Stage7 Evaluate the explanation and its limits
challenge-and-replicate-an-explanation.responsibility: Independent challenge, reproducibility limits and alternative explanations

compare-technical-alternatives.stage: Stage5 Recommend a bounded next action
compare-technical-alternatives.responsibility: Constraints before preferences, raw evidence, uncertainty and reversibility

assess-transfer-to-a-new-context.stage: Stage2 Map preserved changed and unknown assumptions
assess-transfer-to-a-new-context.responsibility: Preserved, changed and unknown assumptions in the target context

write-an-insight-record.responsibility: Separate observations, interpretation, evidence, applicability and decisions

review-and-revise-knowledge.stage: Stage2 Review evidence and downstream consequences
review-and-revise-knowledge.responsibility: New evidence, correction history and dependent-summary review

map-a-technical-landscape.stage: Stage2 Map mechanisms and competing approaches
map-a-technical-landscape.responsibility: Comparable mechanisms, scope, family-aware counting and legal limits

structure-and-prioritize-hypotheses.stage: Stage4 Build rival explanations and a model
structure-and-prioritize-hypotheses.responsibility: Issue structure, rivals, discrimination value and consequential priorities

scan-technology-signals.responsibility: Dated original signals, counter-signals, coverage and a search stopping rule

assess-technology-readiness.stage: Stage2 Map mechanisms and competing approaches

evaluate-a-research-opportunity.responsibility: Need, incumbent, novelty, basis, beneficiaries, risks and falsifiable milestones

explore-technical-contradictions.responsibility: Candidate mechanisms, resources, opposing properties and downside tests

build-a-conditional-technology-roadmap.stage: Stage5 Recommend a bounded next action
build-a-conditional-technology-roadmap.responsibility: Needs, capabilities, dependencies, owners, evidence gates and fallback paths

meaning: Routing and completeness check only; not proof of equivalent efficacy or scientific validity.
